nodes.name: Resolve publish mode
nodes.notes: Phase 18A: PUBLISH_MODE must be 'manual_review'. Any other value is overridden to manual_review. Timeout_auto and full_auto are kept for future activation but are NEVER honored in this slice.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/alert (review-ready)
nodes.notes: Persists to analytics_events. The admin UI reads these to surface 'Review ready' on the editorial item. A future Telegram adapter (separate workflow) can also subscribe to this same alert.

nodes.name: Wait for explicit human decision
nodes.notes: manual_review: WAIT indefinitely. NO 1-hour auto-pass. Item remains at status=waiting_human_review and wp_post_status=draft until the operator issues an explicit decision through the existing /api/admin/editorial/[id]/approval endpoint (admin session) or /api/automation/approval-status (which is read-only).

nodes.name: Promote FF90-05 output
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: terminal promote. Re-emits canonical envelope. No wp-publish call. APPROVE does NOT auto-publish.
